claim: For every \(a>0\), integer \(n\ge 0\), and \(1\le p\le\infty\), let \(H_n^p(\mathbb C^+) = \{F\in H(\mathbb C^+):F^{(j)}\in H^p(\mathbb C^+),\ 0\le j\le n\}\) with norm \(\sum_{j=0}^n\|F^{(j)}\|_{H^p}\). The bounded multiplier \((M_aF)(z)=e^{iaz}F(z)\) has Fredholm essential spectrum exactly \(\overline{\mathbb D}=\{\lambda\in\mathbb C:|\lambda|\le1\}\).
integrity: The proof is explicit and uses analytic interpolation, boundary integral scaling, and Fredholm range criteria. The literature comparison was bounded and does not certify absolute novelty.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the symbol \(e^{iaz}\) with \(a>0\) on the derivative-defined spaces \(H_n^p(\mathbb C^+)\) for \(n\ge0\) and \(1\le p\le\infty\). No classification for general multipliers or index formula for other symbols is asserted. A broader theorem for this exact Banach scale may exist outside the bounded search.
title: Fredholm essential spectrum of exponential multipliers on upper-half-plane Hardy–Sobolev spaces
